name: Advisor Duskingdawn
summary: Advisor Duskingdawn is a blood elf advisor stationed at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She serves as a point of contact for travelers arriving in the settlement on official Horde business.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Presence
sections.body: Standing watch in Tarren Mill, Advisor Duskingdawn is among the few blood elves operating within Lordaeron alongside the Horde. The hamlet serves as a fortified forward base against the Alliance in Southshore and the Syndicate lingering in the hills, making regional coordination essential. Duskingdawn receives dispatch reports and ensures new arrivals assist with local operations.

faq.answer: Advisor Duskingdawn is a blood elf advisor stationed in Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills, acting as an administrative presence for Horde affairs in the region.
She is located inside the settlement of Tarren Mill in northern Hillsbrad Foothills, coordinating regional tasks alongside Forsaken and orcish authorities.

faq.q: Why is a blood elf in Tarren Mill?
aliases: why is blood elf in hillsbrad
faq.answer: Duskingdawn represents diplomatic and advisory interests within Lordaeron, helping direct resources and personnel who arrive to stabilize Tarren Mill against local threats.

angles.text: For Horde couriers and fighters, reporting to Advisor Duskingdawn is an early step in coordinating the defense of Tarren Mill against regional hostilities.
